page.overview:
Who is Walter Bazaar?

Walter Levi Bazaar is the husband of Pomona Krupp and the father of Alberta, Hazel and Violet Bazaar.

Based on Walter's position in the Simpson family tree, he is a third cousin-in-law of Homer Simpson.

He is on the family tree through marriage yet he look like Bart expect having a mustache, glasses and 11 spikes on his head while Bart has 9.

He lives in Springfield since two of his three daughters were seen.
